newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended higher across the board on Tuesday, reflecting the yen's fall against the dollar and a firmer CBOT corn market overnight, traders said.
Prices were 80 yen to 130 yen higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract up 80 yen at 15,950 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 34,781 lots.
Buying from local investors emerged from the opening, and the yen's weaker tone gave further encouragement, traders said.
The spot May contract on CBOT Project A traded at $2.99-3/4 per bushel at 0815 GMT, unchanged from Monday's close.
The spot May CBOT soybean futures contract on the overnight trading system was at $8.36 at 0815 GMT, down from $8.37 at Monday's close.
